item.title: Baldwin Co. grand jury indicts man for sex crimes against children
item.description: A Baldwin County grand jury recently returned a nine-count indictment against a local man stemming from sexual-related crimes against children as victims.

item.title: CHANCEY: Ten reasons death is precious in the sight of the Lord
item.description: The news no pastor wants to receive came by phone one December morning over a decade ago. My wife and I had just left home to travel two hours to her family’s Christmas gathering.

item.title: GRIFFIN: Week 1: Boots on the Ground at the Capitol
item.description: Last week, the Georgia General Assembly was not in formal session. However, important work continued as the House Appropriations Committee met to begin its review of the governor’s proposed state budget.

item.title: EDITORIAL: Road safety a shared responsibility
item.description: Earlier this month, a Georgia Department of Transportation crew went to work on emergency repairs for a bridge on state Route 22 in Baldwin County. A work crew poured concrete into a hole in the bridge, which had to be shut down temporarily. The needed repair was very close to the median in the roadway.

item.title: Retired lieutenant colonel, longtime pastor Billy M. Hargrove passes away at 100
item.description: The Rev. Billy Moran Hargrove’s life was about helping and encouraging people of all races, young and old alike.

item.title: Baldwin Co. avoids winter ice storm by a few degrees
item.description: A degree or two can make all the difference in the world when it comes to winter storm predictions.

item.title: Woman escapes burning house
item.description: A woman trapped inside a burning home last week in Milledgeville managed to free herself and escape out the back door.

item.title: Hancock girls stop GMC Prep win streak at 3 games
item.description: The Georgia Military College Prep girls basketball team went into Friday’s play at the Lew Cordell Gym looking for a four-game winning streak in Region 5-A Division II. However, a disastrous second half — where they could not double the point total from the first half — ended the streak at three straight.

item.title: Atrium Health Navicent offers high school students an opportunity to learn about health careers
item.description: Atrium Health Navicent is accepting applications for a four-week summer program that offers area high school sophomores and juniors the opportunity to shadow health care workers and receive hands-on training for health care careers.

item.title: Chairman Butts discusses new leadership role
item.description: Kendrick Butts is Baldwin County’s new commission chairman for 2026.
